recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with striking blue eyes and voluminous dark hair, captured with the warm, slightly grainy texture of 1970s analog film. The subject is posed with one arm raised behind her head, creating a dynamic diagonal line across the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant blue of the eyes acts as the primary focal point against warm skin tones.
The diagonal line of the raised arm balances the tilt of the head.
The soft, diffused lighting minimizes harsh shadows on the skin and hair.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is centered horizontally but tilted, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, with the arm extending to the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one closer to the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the raised arm down to the face, settling on the eyes and mouth.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right and top edges consist of a flat, neutral studio backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones (peach, tan) and brunette hair (deep brown).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool grey-blue background providing a neutral stage.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid cerulean blue in the irises.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a compressed value range, avoiding deep blacks or blown-out whites to maintain a vintage film look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s style portrait of a woman with blue eyes and long brown hair. She should have one arm raised behind her head. Use a neutral grey-blue studio background. Apply a film grain texture and warm, diffused lighting typical of Ektachrome or Kodachrome film.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, spaced-out sans-serif or a classic 70s serif like ITC Souvenir, placed in the negative space of the upper right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the focus soft rather than digitally sharp?
Are the eyes the most saturated element?
Is the skin tone warm and natural?
Does the grain feel organic to film?

mustRedesign: Avoid heavy contouring or modern makeup styles
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic hair strands and flyaways.
Ensure the blue of the eyes looks luminous but integrated.
Verify the diagonal composition feels balanced.
Confirm the background is a flat, non-distracting studio color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus lens effect with a warm analog color palette, centering a human subject in a relaxed, diagonal pose against a muted, cool-toned studio backdrop.
